PICKET 1.1 — temporary voice channels

Need one voice channel, or several for an operation? Use /voice create, choose your templates and quantities, then deploy your queue in one go. No dedicated request channel needed.

Officers can configure up to 10 templates in /voice settings: destination category, channel name, capacity (1–99) and automatic cleanup after the channel stays empty (15 minutes by default, up to 30).

Deploy up to 6 channels by default (officers can raise this to 10), with at most 15 open or reserved channels per server. Tracking survives restarts.

Server admins: grant PICKET Manage Channels and visibility of the destination categories to use the feature. No new intents, audit-log access or voice connection required.

Guide: <https://docs.picket-foxhole.com/guide/voice>
Source: <https://github.com/NapoSky/picket>
